scope: Frozen summary of completed numerical audits; not a substitute for raw matrices or a rerun of the published age-trajectory model.

datasets.role: published Leiden validation cohort reanalysis; not independent of the 2026 paper's reported validation
datasets.interpretation: Unadjusted descriptive group contrast does not reproduce a higher score. It is not an exact test of the published age-trajectory model; age ranges do not overlap, so adjusted extrapolation would be weakly identified.

datasets.role: distinct Japanese supercentenarian PBMC cohort; reused across multiple papers and counted once
datasets.interpretation: The score direction is opposite to the published Chinese cohort association. Small donor count and leave-one-donor-out sensitivity limit inference; no gene-wise FDR result is significant.

upstream_regulator_screen.reported_context: Cytosolic ribosomal activity and fibroblast senescence in a separate healthy-aging study
upstream_regulator_screen.required_test: Test ETS1 occupancy/expression and perturbation against the exact eight mitochondrial ribosomal genes in relevant human cell types; include rescue and matched controls.

upstream_regulator_screen.reported_context: Mitochondrial ribosomal perturbation, mitonuclear protein imbalance and UPRmt in model systems
upstream_regulator_screen.required_test: Treat as a pathway perturbation comparator, not an upstream regulator; assess graded perturbation/rescue and mitochondrial translation/respiration.

cross_dataset_pooling.reason: GSE16717 normalized microarray group z-score contrast and RIKEN donor-level pseudobulk count-based score are different estimands, tissues/processing contexts and statistical designs; combining them as a single replicated effect would be invalid.
